❓ How to Play

🕹 Move: touch left half → virtual joystick. Desktop: WASD.
👆 Camera: drag right half of screen · pinch to zoom. Desktop: drag mouse.
⚔️ Sword: center button chops forward, left/right buttons cut from that side (needs stamina). 🏹 Bow: shoot arrows.
🌀 Dodge: roll with brief invincibility. ✋ Talk: interact with NPCs.
❗ Quests: accept from NPCs, objectives appear on your tracker and gold markers on the minimap.
🏘️ Settlements: walk through the gate of the Village, Castle or Barracks to open its menu — market, army, notice board and people are all listed there.
🛒 Market: buy arrows, potions, sword/bow/armor upgrades. Sell loot.
🛡 Army: at the Barracks, recruit Militia, Archers and Knights to fight beside you.
🏟 Tournament: pay 50g at the Arena, win 3 rounds for a big prize.
🏴 Hideout: clear the bandits and stand on their campfire to capture it.
🗺 World Map: tap the map icon (top-right) to travel — settlements are safer, wild spots throw you straight into a fight.
🎨 Trophy Shop: spend gold on joystick colors in the pause menu.
💾 Save: auto-saves every 90s + pause menu.
